ref_entities: test the Repo class initialization that creates a wgit directory with sha1_store and git tracking
test the Repo add method that tracks PyTorch checkpoint files with optional per_tensor and gzip options
test the Repo commit method that saves tracked changes with a commit message to the git log
test the Repo status method that returns CLEAN, CHANGES_ADDED_NOT_COMMITED, or CHANGES_NOT_ADDED for tracked files
test the Repo log method that prints the version history of a tracked checkpoint file
test the wgit cli init command to create a new checkpoint version control repository
test the wgit cli add command to stage a PyTorch checkpoint file for commit
test the wgit cli commit command to commit staged checkpoint changes with a message
test the wgit cli status command to check the cleanliness of tracked checkpoint files
test the wgit cli log command to display the commit history of the repository
test the PyGit class initialization with a parent path and gitignore list
test the PyGit add method to stage all untracked files in the wgit repo
test the PyGit commit method to commit staged changes with a message
test the PyGit status method to get file status codes from the wgit repo
test the PyGit teardown cleanup to remove the temp wgit testing directory
test the SHA1_Store add method by storing PyTorch checkpoint files with optional compression
test the SHA1_Store add method by storing PyTorch state dicts and verifying ref counts
test the SHA1_Store add method by storing a PyTorch tensor and checking the SHA1 key
test the SHA1_Store get method by retrieving stored files, state dicts, and tensors by SHA1 hash
test the SHA1_Store delete method with reference counting to ensure entries are removed correctly
create a SignalSparsity instance with sst_top_k_element and dst_top_k_element to configure sparsity
test the dense_to_sst method to convert a dense tensor into sparse signal space via FFT
test the dense_sst_to_dst method to compute the DST tensor from dense and SST inputs
test the sst_dst_to_dense method to reconstruct a dense tensor from SST and DST tensors
test the lossy_compress method to perform end-to-end lossy compression returning reconstructed tensor, SST, and DST
test the EnergyConcentrationProfile measure method with a PyTorch tensor on a specified dimension
test the EnergyConcentrationProfile measure_fft method to measure FFT energy concentration on a tensor
test that CPU runs ahead of GPU in the ECP measuring process with a large tensor
test ECP measure and measure_fft output against expected tensors using parametrize test cases
test creating an EnergyConcentrationProfile instance with a dimension and top_k_percents list
